selection: 100 core lemmas: 94 unique lemmas from a fixed-seed audit of the first 1000 offline translation attempts, plus de/i/el/a/que/en by core-first priorityRank. Chinese corrections were written by Codex through direct source comparison, not imported from machine output. Up to three selected, source-backed senses per lemma; additional original Catalan evidence resolves ambiguous isolated English glosses. This is partial sense coverage and not human lexicographer approval.
